entry.title: New: Resolution 576 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Council: Adopts Res. 576-26 & GOEAC-137 - 06/17/26
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN INTERGOVERNMENTAL AGREEMENT WITH THE STATE OF HAWAIʻI, DEPARTMENT OF BUSINESS, ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT, AND TOURISM, TO RECEIVE A GRANT FOR THE KONA LOW BUSINESS RECOVERY PROGRAM

Allows for the receipt of $500,000 to be provided to eligible Hawaiʻi Island small businesses that sustained material economic or physical damage from the recent Kona Low storm.
